text: and then one more for you on top of that, if you look here [Image #11] this gap between me and the model is an invisible wall, the physics rect is not exact to the model
resolution: Fixed the invisible wall: world_loader.zig's one-box mesh collider (meshFullBoundsIsland) built a box CENTERED on the mesh anchor from footprint w/d — assuming symmetry the authored rock doesn't have, so the collider overhung the visible face. New meshVertexBoundsIsland scans the actual solid vertices and boxes their true AABB; the single-island and degenerate fallbacks use it, and the centered footprint guess survives only for vertex-less meshes. Remaining honest caveat: colliders are still boxes — a sloped face keeps a small gap where the box meets its widest point, plus the player capsule's radius; making colliders hug slopes needs multi-slab decomposition (a follow-up if wanted). Rides the same pending dev-host rebuild as req_2832/2833.
